method: Live read-only pg_attribute + pg_attrdef + pg_class + pg_namespace; complete available column DDL components grouped and directly semantically read; full per-column expressions retained, source md5 for precise future drift. No data rows.

per_schema_queries.auth:
WITH raw AS (
SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,cls.relname AS relation_name,a.attnum AS position,a.attname AS column_name,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS data_type,a.attnotnull AS not_null,a.attidentity::text AS identity_kind,a.attgenerated::text AS generated_kind,a.attstorage::text AS storage_kind,a.attcompression::text AS compression_kind,pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) AS default_expr,CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 OR a.attcollation='default'::regcollation THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END AS collation_name,cls.relrowsecurity AS rls_enabled,pg_get_userbyid(cls.relowner) AS owner_role,coalesce(a.attacl::text,'') AS explicit_column_acl
FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class cls ON cls.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=cls.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum
WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND cls.relkind IN('r','p','v','m','f') AND n.nspname='auth'),
norm AS (
SELECT *,concat_ws(' ',quote_ident(column_name),data_type,
CASE WHEN identity_kind='a' THEN 'GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY' WHEN identity_kind='d' THEN 'GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY' END,
CASE WHEN generated_kind='s' THEN 'GENERATED ALWAYS AS ('||default_expr||') STORED' WHEN generated_kind='v' THEN 'GENERATED ALWAYS AS ('||default_expr||') VIRTUAL' END,
CASE WHEN default_expr IS NOT NULL AND generated_kind='' THEN 'DEFAULT '||default_expr END,
CASE WHEN collation_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'COLLATE '||collation_name END,
CASE WHEN not_null THEN 'NOT NULL' END) AS column_ddl
FROM raw), numbered AS (SELECT row_number() over(order by relation_name COLLATE "C", position)::int AS schema_ordinal,*,md5(column_ddl) AS column_ddl_md5 FROM norm)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('count',(SELECT count(*) FROM numbered),'rows',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(numbered) ORDER BY schema_ordinal) FROM numbered)) AS data

findings.note: Auth flow_state, OAuth custom provider client_secret, users encrypted_password, MFA factor secret and recovery hashes are declared as data columns, not disclosed. No Auth row contents were accessed; no direct Auth schema modification authorized.

realtime.subscription stores claims, generated claims_role and selected_columns, with RLS disabled and prior verified client-role SELECT at catalog level; zero live subscriptions previously aggregated. Hosted REST/Realtime exposure and JWT session behavior require #96 verification; no exploit proven.

storage.buckets.public has default FALSE and objects.path_tokens is generated from name. These defaults are not sufficient proof of hosted file/bucket authorization; no Storage files or bucket object rows accessed.

vault.decrypted_secrets has visible decrypted_secret text column and depends on a privileged decrypting view. Prior run26 verified anon/authenticated lack direct schema USAGE and SELECT; no secret value accessed or hosted API behavior proven.

439 complete visible provider/extension table or view column declaration components reviewed: Auth 271, Extensions 51, Realtime 21, Storage 73, migration records 6, Vault 17. Compiled service implementation and runtime remain unverified.

limitations: No Auth identities/rows, member data, Storage file bytes, Vault secrets, private query contents, or sensitive log bodies were read.
Provider data schema declaration is not hosted Auth/API/REST/JWT/Storage/Realtime security acceptance; #96 owns signed-in runtime tests.
Native provider service and C compiled implementations cannot be reviewed with SQL metadata; do not credit full source semantics.
Previous column ACL and view/function/table receipts reused without duplicate credit.
No DDL/DML/Auth/Storage/Edge/config changes; no code/test/CI runner performed, docs-only governance CI requires exact-source readback.
next: Unreviewed provider-console-only configurations and hosted Auth/JWT/PostgREST/Realtime/Storage API boundaries; source-dependent ACL and drift verification with #96, and formal reconcile of existing 3,319 pg_catalog declaration receipts. If complete accessible baseline proven, continue hourly delta.
